column1: # The specimens the operator has not reviewed: PROFILE and why. A
# provisional profile that moves is reported as drift and fails nothing,
# and may go undrawn where its set cannot be built; a row goes when the
# operator accepts the profile, which then fails on a moved pixel.

column2: #144: redrawn on 2026-11-14 with ADR-1006, ADR-1203 and the fix that shows every character of a cluster a bitmap font draws from its parts: against the drawing before these, 42 pixels of screen-1, and 162 pixels of screen-5 move, and their collage with them. The Devanagari line नमस्ते दुनिया now shows every vowel sign and the त of स्ते, each cluster's pieces in its two cells (ADR-1006, ADR-1203's note on bitmap fonts). Screen-1's line of letters with combining marks now draws each mark, as the precomposed letters beside it do. The scripts screen also now shows the keycaps and the marks of its Latin, Hebrew, Tamil and Thai samples, which the specimens' face had dropped. Not reviewed yet
